source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #315 (branch fix/201-component-bundles at head 9bdd30033dfbff2eece920ed0e22fa9ae04b22a6 — the #201 change (component bundles: hash-keyed AoT artifacts for the core modules embedded in a component; commits aa60653, 9e1c649 and 6ffbfd8) merged with current main b868802f3ae377dccc28d54ba73560bb5e55bd79 (PR #329); ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45534017783, 45534029382 and 45534039628 against the branch and pull-request run 45533984355, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #315 (#201, component bundles: hash-keyed AoT artifacts for the core modules embedded in a component). Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45534050177, 45534060121 and 45534068404 on main at b868802f3ae377dccc28d54ba73560bb5e55bd79; all three runs pass the gate). The main control reproduces the checked-in baseline exactly on all 32 gated series, so no part of the gate failure is main-side staleness. This PR's own delta against the main control is confined to the three configurations that link telomere-component (component, wasi, wasi-threads): in release, stripped file +1,456 B and stripped .text +1,248 B in each; in release-size, stripped file +192 B / stripped .text +144 B in component and wasi-threads, and +208 B / +160 B in wasi. Every other configuration is byte-identical to main in both profiles. The bundle implementation proper (bundle.rs, the substitution decode session, the instantiate-time install path) is gated behind telomere-component's aot-bundle feature, which the minimal embedder does not enable, so the linked delta is the code-layout effect of the PR's component-layer changes on those configurations; the core library is untouched. The delta covers the whole PR, including the Codex follow-ups on it: the bundle load harness moved to benches/, the checked length arithmetic in the bundle reader, and the alias-identity resolution in runtime/env.rs (a core instance instantiated through an alias export of a nested component's module now resolves to the module's definition index before the artifact lookup). Against the checked-in baseline the gate therefore tripped on 12 of the 32 gated series. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth is now the release component stripped file series at +9.85% (2,433,656 B to 2,673,368 B), overtaking the release core-nosimd stripped file series at +9.83% (1,275,448 B to 1,400,840 B), which this PR does not change. The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the three branch samples and across the three main samples.
